module.name: Examples
module.purpose: 20-domain resonance-aware example curriculum — 12 original academic subject suites (problems, solutions, extended problems, resonance flows) plus 11 expansion RTT domain documents covering earth sciences through security and resilience.

modules_linked: 12 subject folders × 6 files each — problem/solution/extended/flow/index/readme per domain
9 subjects carry embedded RTT_Domain_*.md specs — linking examples to formal domain definitions
11 root-level RTT_Domain expansion docs — extending coverage to 20 total domains
resonance_flow.md files → tft/tops/ — flow diagrams demonstrate triconceptual modes in practice
problems.md/solutions.md → formats/ — examples consume .fff format conventions
session_context.coherence: stable (consistent 6-file structure per domain + RTT domain expansion pattern)

imports: tft-3pack (parent module — dimensional envelope, audience, canon context)
formats (the .fff format consumed by example problems and solutions)
exports: Per-domain resonance flow diagrams (D3→D6→D9 operator application)
